entries.summary: NEXT PHASE: implement the mercury-services-commons cloud-sdk gaps (Wave 0) before any module migration. Order: S-G2, W-G9, X-G7 — all strictly additive to libs consumed in production by mercury-services.
entries.detail:
Wave 0 gap implementations (in mercury-services-commons, target line 1.0.27-SNAPSHOT):
S-G2 (cloud-sdk-api + cloud-sdk-aws): StorageClient.putObject(bucket,key,byte[],Map metadata,String contentType) + InputStream variant + copyObject(...,Map replacedMetadata,String contentType) (S3 REPLACE). Consumers: event-writer, dispatcher, distributor, error-processor (+ transformer/splitter ref).
W-G9 (cloud-sdk-api): (1) add annotations + setAnnotations to Event.Builder and copy in Builder(Event) — fixes the WIRE round-trip defect where Event.parseJson silently drops an annotations block (W-G9.1); (2) add the 6 missing MetaData.Projection + 8 missing Event.Token String constants (W-G9.2, source-compat only). Gate: JSON round-trip corpus test (event-writer S3 archives) asserting appianway-shared serialization == cloud-sdk-api serialization, byte-stable, incl. an annotations-bearing payload.
X-G7 (cloud-sdk-api + SES): additive replyTo field + builder setter on MailContent, mapped by SesEmailServiceImpl to SES v2 replyToAddresses. Consumer: email-sender. Fallback if not delivered: email-sender composes Reply-To locally against the underlying SesV2Client.
De-scoped (NOT cloud-sdk changes): DynamoDB optimistic lock (native v2 @DynamoDbVersionAttribute), Thymeleaf/Handlebars template, health helpers. X-G8 (ingestor Jest signing) CORRECTED: keep the vc.inreach v1 SigV4 signer + a minimal AWS v1 auth jar coexisting with v2 — NO cloud-sdk change.
Non-negotiable contract: every gap change must be strictly additive (new default methods, overloads, types, visibility-widening only); verify cloud-sdk CI + full mercury-services build green before/after.
After Wave 0 lands: appianway-commons (slim residue) + functional-testing fakes, then the 5-wave module rollout (event-writer pilot first, gated on the W-G9 corpus test).
